FIRELIGHT FROM ONE SIDE: deep orange light raking in low from the left, long shadows stretching lazily across the floor, every far surface blushing into warm brown and amber
FIRELIGHT FROM THE RIGHT: rich orange light pouring in from low on the right, shadows pulling long and soft away across the stone, the far wall deepening into toasted caramel
TANGERINE SIDELIGHT: warm tangerine light slanting in from one low side, shadows reaching wide and gentle across the floor, the opposite edge of everything glowing a sleepy golden brown
COPPER FLANK LIGHT: a low blaze of copper-orange light washing in from the left flank, shadows sprawling long across the floor, the far reaches of the hall mellowing into deep tawny warmth
AMBER LOW SIDELIGHT: amber-orange light spilling in low from one side, long tender shadows traveling across the floor away from the source, every distant surface warming to a deep honey brown
FURNACE GLOW FROM BELOW: warm amber light rising from floor level, every ledge and overhang lit softly underneath, the upper hall settling into deep velvety shadow
GOLDEN UPLIGHT FROM THE FLOOR: golden-orange light climbing up from the floor, catching the undersides of every surface, the heights of the hall drifting into a rich and cozy dimness
PALE COPPER WELLING UP: pale copper light welling up from below, edging everything from underneath in a gentle glow, the whole upper space softening into warm shadow above
HONEY UPLIGHT, AMBER DUSK ABOVE: honey-warm light rising from the floor upward, every lower edge touched with quiet gold, the ceiling retreating into a deep and inviting amber dusk
COOL DAY MEETING THE FIRE: pale blue-white daylight falling from a high opening and meeting warm orange rising from below, shadows split into cool lavender on one side and amber gold on the other
CERULEAN ABOVE, ORANGE BELOW: soft cerulean light drifting down from above and blending with furnace orange rising to greet it, shadows wearing cool blue on one cheek and warm peach on the other
PERIWINKLE AND TANGERINE SPLIT: icy periwinkle light pouring from high above and kissing the warm tangerine glow from below, each shadow split cleanly into one cool side and one blushing warm side
STEEL-BLUE GAP OVER AMBER: pale steel-blue light washing down from a lofty gap and meeting the amber furnace glow, shadows dividing their allegiance between cool silver-blue and honeyed orange
EMBER LOW LIGHT: a dim red bed of coals glowing from floor level, the whole hall swimming in deep warm shadow, only the softest crimson edges showing where surfaces catch the light
RUBY COAL GLOW: faint ruby light radiating outward from low glowing coals, deep warm shadow blanketing the hall, every edge barely kissed with a soft and rosy red
GARNET BED, DEEP SHADOW: a quiet garnet glow spreading from a low coal bed, the hall wrapped in deep shadow, only the gentlest red-rose edges picking out where surfaces lean toward the warmth
LANTERN-LIT: a handful of hanging lanterns spilling small pools of honey-gold light downward, deep gentle shadow settling between each pool like a soft pause in the warmth
SWAYING LANTERN POOLS: a few swaying lanterns pouring warm amber pools across the floor, generous gaps of soft shadow drifting between them in quiet comfortable waves
BUTTERSCOTCH LANTERN CIRCLES: scattered hanging lanterns glowing a rich butterscotch, their warm light falling in cozy circles, the spaces between them drifting into gentle and welcoming shadow
MOLTEN UNDERLIGHT: low amber light lying along the floor from a molten channel, rose-gold warmth washing up the walls to waist height, everything above fading into a deep and quiet cool
AMBER-ROSE FLOOR GLOW: a warm amber-rose glow lying close along the floor, the lower walls flushed pink and gold, the upper hall resting in soft and contented shadow
ROSE-AMBER CHANNEL LIGHT: pale rose-amber light spreading from a low molten channel across the floor, the walls glowing warm and peachy to the waist, the heights above left dark and pleasantly calm
BLUE HOUR THROUGH THE ARCHES: deep violet evening light drifting in through open arches and meeting the hall's own warm orange, shadows blending into soft lilac where the two tones find each other
INDIGO DUSK AT THE ARCHES: cool indigo-blue light flowing in through the arches at dusk and touching the amber furnace glow, the join between them melting into a soft and dreamy mauve
VIOLET TWILIGHT AGAINST THE HEART: gentle violet twilight washing in through open arches against the hall's warm orange heart, shadows softening at the meeting point into a quiet and magical plum
